stories.title: Follow live: Brewers in control with NLCS matchup vs. Dodgers in sight
Fan called for interference in Bronx as Yankees lose out on tying, 2-run HR
stories.summary: Fan interference was called in the sixth inning of Wednesday night's AL Division Series Game 3 at Yankee Stadium.

stories.title: Pages lifts Dodgers to third straight NLCS with redemptive series
stories.summary: The Dodgers beat the Braves 4-1 to clinch the best-of-five matchup in Game 4 and advance to their third straight NLCS.

stories.title: Reese scores 23 as Dream hold off Liberty in OT for 2-0 series lead
stories.summary: Angel Reese scored 23 points, Naz Hillmon made the go-ahead layup with 20.8 seconds left in overtime and the Atlanta Dream beat the New York Liberty 101-98 on Wednesday night to take a 2-0 lead in the WNBA semifinals.

stories.title: 'Hyped' Haliburton plays 16 minutes in return from Achilles injury
stories.summary: Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton scored seven points during his 16 minutes of action against the Wolves on Wednesday. It was his first game in more than 16 months, as Haliburton was recovering from a torn Achilles.
